blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Coach Tim Cone summed up how Barangay Ginebra made the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals the hard way, and at the cost of having to face San Miguel Beer in a best-of-five series. “It’s consuelo de bobo,” Cone said after Ginebra secured the last ticket with Friday’s 101-96 win over Blackwater at Ynares Center here. “You fight your way to the playoffs, and your reward is that you have to face San Miguel.” The Gin Kings qualified for the next phase of the season-ending conference after dealing with the scary situation of needing to be in playoff mode late in the […]...
